_comment_deed_1: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah kuma godiya ta tabbata a gare Shi (Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi)
deed_1_title: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah kuma godiya ta tabbata a gare Shi
deed_1_reward: Za a dasa maka itacen dabino a Aljanna
deed_1_hadith: Duk wanda ya ce 'Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi', za a dasa masa itacen dabino a cikin Aljanna.
deed_1_source: Tirmidhi ya ruwaito, Albani ya inganta shi
_comment_deed_2: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah Mai girma kuma godiya ta tabbata a gare Shi
deed_2_title: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah Mai girma kuma godiya ta tabbata a gare Shi
deed_2_hadith: Kalmomi biyu masu sauƙi a kan harshe, masu nauyi a kan mizani (sikeli), kuma ababen so ga Mai Rahama: 'Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, Subhanallahil Azim'.
_comment_deed_3: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah kuma godiya ta tabbata a gare Shi (Sau 100)
deed_3_title: Tsarki ya tabbata ga Allah kuma godiya ta tabbata a gare Shi (Sau 100)
deed_3_reward: Kankare zunubai koda sun kai kumfan teku
deed_3_hadith: Duk wanda ya ce 'Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi' sau dari a yini, za a kankare masa zunubansa koda sun kai irin kumfan teku.
deed_4_reward: Za a gina maka gida a Aljanna
deed_4_hadith: Wanda ya karanta 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad' sau goma, Allah zai gina masa fada a cikin Aljanna.
deed_4_source: Ahmad ya ruwaito, Albani ya inganta shi
_comment_deed_5: Babu dabarar kaucewa sabo, babu karfin yin da'a, sai da taimakon Allah
deed_5_title: Babu dabarar kaucewa sabo, babu karfin yin da'a, sai da taimakon Allah
deed_5_hadith: Shin in nuna maka wata kalma wadda take taska ce daga taskokin Aljanna? Ita ce 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah'.
_comment_deed_6: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah Shi kadai, ba Shi da abokin tarayya. Mulki Nansa ne kuma godiya Tasa ce, kuma Shi Mai iko ne a kan komai
deed_6_title: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah Shi kadai, ba Shi da abokin tarayya. Mulki Nansa ne kuma godiya Tasa ce, kuma Shi Mai iko ne a kan komai
deed_6_reward: Lada 100, goge zunubi 100, da tsari daga Shaidan
deed_6_hadith: Wanda ya fadi wannan sau dari a yini zai samu kwatankwacin ladan 'yanta bayi goma, a rubuta masa lada dari, a goge masa kurakurai dari, kuma ta zame masa tsari daga Shaidan.
deed_7_reward: Salati 10 daga Allah, kankare zunubi 10, da daukaka daraja 10
deed7_hadith: Duk wanda ya yi mini salati guda daya, Allah zai yi masa salati goma, ya kankare masa laifuka goma, ya daukaka masa daraja goma.
_comment_deed_8: Ina neman gafarar Allah kuma ina tuba zuwa gare Shi
deed_8_title: Ina neman gafarar Allah kuma ina tuba zuwa gare Shi
deed_8_reward: Yaye kowace damuwa da mafita daga kowane kunci
deed8_hadith: Wanda ya lizimti istigfari, Allah zai sanya masa mafita a kowane kunci, da sauki a kowace damuwa, kuma Ya azurta shi ta inda ba ya tsammani.
deed8_source: Abu Dawud da Ibn Majah suka ruwaito
_comment_deed_9: Karatun Ayatul Kursiyyi bayan kowace sallah
deed_9_title: Karatun Ayatul Kursiyyi bayan kowace sallah
deed_9_reward: Babu abin da zai hana shi shiga Aljanna sai mutuwa
deed_9_hadith: Duk wanda ya karanta Ayatul Kursiyyi a bayan kowace sallar farilla, babu abin da zai hana shi shiga Aljanna sai mutuwa.
deed_9_source: Nasa'i ya ruwaito, Albani ya inganta shi
_comment_deed_10: Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar
deed_10_title: Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar
deed_10_reward: Kalmomin da Allah Ya fi so
deed10_hadith: Kalmomin da Allah Ya fi so su ne guda hudu: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar.
deed_11_reward: Za a gafarta zunubansa koda sun kai kumfan teku
deed_11_hadith: Wanda ya yi tasbihi (Subhanallah) 33, ya yi tahmidi (Alhamdulillah) 33, ya yi takbiri (Allahu Akbar) 33 (ko 34) bayan kowace sallah, an gafarta masa zunubansa.
_comment_deed_12: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah (La ilaha illallah)
deed_12_title: Babu abin bautawa da gaskiya sai Allah
deed_12_reward: Mafi alherin abin da Annabawa suka fada
deed_12_hadith: Mafi alherin zikiri shi ne 'La ilaha illallah', kuma mafi alherin addu'a ita ce 'Alhamdulillah'.
deed_12_source: Tirmidhi da Ibn Majah suka ruwaito
deed_13_hadith: Tsarki rabin imani ne, kuma 'Alhamdulillah' tana cika Mizani.
_comment_deed_14: Da sunan Allah wanda babu wani abu a cikin kasa ko a sama da zai iya yin cutarwa tare da sunanSa, kuma Shi ne Mai ji, Mai sani (Sau 3)
deed_14_title: Da sunan Allah wanda babu wani abu a cikin kasa ko a sama da zai iya yin cutarwa tare da sunanSa, kuma Shi ne Mai ji, Mai sani (Sau 3)
deed_14_hadith: Wanda ya fadi wannan sau uku da safe kuma sau uku da yamma babu wani abu da zai cutar da shi.
deed_14_source: Abu Dawud da Tirmidhi suka ruwaito
_comment_deed_15: Ina neman tsari da kalmomin Allah cikakku daga sharrin abin da Ya halitta (Sau 3)
deed_15_title: Ina neman tsari da kalmomin Allah cikakku daga sharrin abin da Ya halitta (Sau 3)
deed_15_hadith: Wanda ya fadi hakan yayin da yamma ta yi sau uku, maciji ko kunama ba za su cutar da shi ba a wannan daren.
